## Official-source verification

Checked on 28 September 2026 against the National Trust's current organiser page:

https://www.nationaltrust.org.uk/visit/bath-bristol/dyrham-park/events/9a079525-234a-471a-9530-156bc4027622

Confirmed:

- Nature Tots is aimed at pre-school children.
- Sessions are Tuesday 29 September and 6, 13 and 20 October 2026, 10:45–11:45.
- A normal session usually includes a song, story, craft and game.
- No booking is needed.
- The event itself is free; normal Dyrham Park admission applies.
- The meeting point is Old Lodge, about a ten-minute walk from the car park.
- Parkland is steep and uneven in places; the organiser advises wellies or sturdy footwear.

Need a plan for Tuesday morning with a preschooler? 🍂

Nature Tots is back at Dyrham Park — one relaxed outdoor hour with a song, story, nature craft and game.

The first session is **tomorrow, Tuesday 29 September**, followed by 6, 13 and 20 October.

📍 Old Lodge, Dyrham Park  
🕥 10.45–11.45am
